algorithm.routing_order: clock, ordinary short nets, power/ground labels, high-fanout labels
algorithm.wire_collision_policy: existing wire grid cells are blocked; adjacent different-net wires receive penalty

algorithm.pin_point_policy: uses placement.pin_points when supplied; otherwise estimates endpoint stubs from component body edges
